note: SYNTHETIC — fictional payer coverage policy authored for a hackathon demo. Not a real coverage document from any plan. Clause text is written to be structurally realistic, not copied from any payer. `criterion.phenotype` matches a patient's `phenotype` (the human name), NOT their `lookup` (CPIC's activity-score join key) — payers write policy in phenotype language, so this is the one place matching is on the display field rather than the key.

clauses.text: Requests for fluoropyrimidine therapy require documentation of DPYD genotype results obtained prior to the first administered dose. Requests submitted without a documented DPYD result will be pended for additional information.

For members with a DPYD result indicating absent dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase activity (poor metabolizer), standard-dose fluoropyrimidine therapy is not covered. Reduced-dose therapy may be authorized when accompanied by a documented plan for early therapeutic drug monitoring.

criterion.alternative: Reduced starting dose with documented therapeutic drug monitoring

clauses.text: For members with a DPYD result indicating reduced activity (intermediate metabolizer), therapy is covered at a reduced starting dose consistent with current published prescribing guidance.
For members with a DPYD result indicating normal activity, fluoropyrimidine therapy is covered per standard plan benefit without additional review.

For members with a CYP2D6 result indicating ultrarapid metabolism, codeine-containing analgesics are not covered due to risk of life-threatening opioid toxicity. Non-codeine analgesic alternatives are covered without prior authorization.
For all other CYP2D6 phenotypes, codeine-containing analgesics are covered per standard plan benefit.

revision.summary: Reduced-dose authorization now additionally requires documented DPD phenotype testing, not genotype alone.
